messages:
Jon (Sales): Handing off NimbusHealth — signed. 500 seats, pilot 30d, customer requires private VPC + KMS. Main risks: SSO/Okta, PHI/data residency, and month-end burst traffic. Assigning to CS to own onboarding.
Aisha (CS): Thanks Jon — I'll own onboarding. Who's the technical contact at Nimbus? Also, any contractual constraints on logging/retention?
Jon (Sales): POC is Dr. Kim (kim@nimbushealth.com). Contract: 7yr data retention waiver denied; default retention applies. They marked SOC2 + HIPAA required, want KMS in their account. Pilot start target 2024-03-30. Renewal window in 11 months — possible churn if security not satisfied. :warning:
Aisha (CS): Noted. I'll schedule intro + security kickoff. Drafting owners now. High-level owner list:
- Aisha (CS): overall onboarding owner, customer comms
- Carla (Support): infra provisioning + infra ticket owner
- Ben (CS-Risk): compliance pack + SOC/HIPAA tracker
- Dorian (Eng): perf + private deploy engineering escalation
- Jon (Sales): commercial/contract questions
Carla (Support): Can you confirm desired CIDR and whether they want peering or transit VPC? Also need SRE runbook access.
Jon (Sales): They prefer peering. CIDR suggested: 10.55.0.0/16. Will confirm service account naming.
Aisha (CS): Service account name: nimbus-inference-sa. I'll request Okta metadata and the list of test users for SSO. Ben, can you start the compliance checklist?
Ben (CS-Risk): Starting compliance pack. I need contact for security questionnaire and timelines. I'll own SOC2 artifact collection and KMS design review. Marking renewal risk: medium-high until SOC2/HIPAA validated.
Dorian (Eng): Quick perf heads-up: model they want = "redwood/large-v1" quantized. For private (single-tenant) we should either allocate an 80GB GPU or shard across two 40GB nodes. I need sample prompt set + expected QPS for month-end burst to size properly.
Aisha (CS): I'll attach prompt set and expected traffic (est. baseline 15 rps, month-end 90 rps bursts).
Carla (Support): Creating infra ticket now.
Carla (Support): INF-4521 created -> https://tickets.internal/INF-4521. Payload: VPC peering request, CIDR 10.55.0.0/16, service-account created, attach KMS key request. Assigned to: Carla. ETA 48h.
Dorian (Eng): Created ENG-980 -> perf test ticket. Need sample prompt set file in the ticket. If we need a temporary larger GPU for tests, call it out.
Aisha (CS): Putting everything into the onboarding playbook and adding owners. Quick checklist I'm adding to playbook: 1) Intro + security kickoff (Aisha, Ben) 2) VPC peering + infra (Carla) 3) Okta SSO test (Aisha, Ben) 4) KMS key access & review (Ben, Security) 5) Perf tests & tuning (Dorian) 6) Pilot go/no-go (All)
Ben (CS-Risk): Also recommend we request a signed BAAs + list of data flows. I'll draft a short questionnaire to send right after kickoff.
Jon (Sales): Good. Sales will prioritize SOC2 attachments in the contract addendum. Will follow-up on BAAs.
Aisha (CS): @deployment-bot create runbook nimbus-onboarding-playbook with checklist and owners
deployment-bot: Runbook 'nimbus-onboarding-playbook' created: https://playbooks.internal/redwood/nimbus-onboarding-playbook
Carla (Support): INF-4521 updated with CIDR and service account names. Added note: needs peering approval from network (team-network).
Dorian (Eng): ENG-980 updated with expected QPS and sample prompts attached. Scheduling perf window for 48h after infra ready.
Ben (CS-Risk): I'll collect SOC2 evidence; filing TRACK-113 to track artifacts and deadlines.
Aisha (CS): Next concrete steps for owners: 1) Aisha schedule intro + send questionnaire (today) 2) Carla finish INF-4521 and request peering (48h) 3) Dorian run perf test after infra (72h) 4) Ben compile compliance pack (5 business days) 5) Jon confirm BAA & contract addendum (EOD).
Jon (Sales): I'll confirm BAA by EOD. Thanks everyone. Keep me posted if exec escalation needed. :thumbsup: :rocket:
